p: creditor that lendeth ought unto his: He shall only release his debtors, who are not able to pay for that year.
Save when there shall be no: For if your debtor is rich, he may be forced to pay.
For the poor shall never cease: To try your charity, Mt 26:11.
open thine hand wide unto thy: You shall be liberal.
furnish him liberally out of thy: In token that you acknowledge the benefit which God has given you by his labours.
for ever: To the year of Jubile, Le 25:40.
hired servant to thee: For the hired servant served but three years, and he six.
thou shalt do no work with: For they are the Lords.
as the roebuck: You will eat them, as well as the roe buck and other wild beasts.
